name: LIBERO
description: A benchmark suite for lifelong robot learning comprising 130 language-conditioned manipulation tasks across four task suites, designed to study knowledge transfer and continual learning. LIBERO is an environment and task benchmark with associated demonstrations, not a single uniform dataset.
citation: Liu, H., et al. (2023). LIBERO: Benchmarking Knowledge Transfer for Lifelong Robot Learning. Proceedings of the Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL). https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.03310
